title: POST /routes – request
description: Create a route on a site of the caller, without checkpoints: they come with POST /routes/{id}/versions. Supervisor token, or the site phone's device token with an X-Acting-User header (then only on the phone's site). Requires an Idempotency-Key header (common/idempotency-key.json). Response: 201 (200 for a repeated id), api/route.response.json.

id.description: Optional client-generated id (UUIDv7) of the new record; the server generates one if absent. A create repeated with this id (the app's outbox, e.g. after its Idempotency-Key expired) creates nothing: if the record exists on the same site_id and the caller sees it, the response is 200 with the record as it is now. A deleted record, or another one with this id, is 409 conflict.

order_mode.description: fixed: checkpoints must be scanned by position; free: any order.
